edges.notes: libbpf loads BPF programs, manages maps, and uses the BPF syscall uAPI against the kernel BPF subsystem.
libbpf targets Linux BPF syscall and netlink/perf adjacency as documented for the reference library.
libbpf exposes a C API for BPF program loading and map lifecycle in userspace.
Typical GNU/Linux BPF tooling links libbpf against glibc.
musl-based Linux userlands may link libbpf in static or dynamic builds.
Clang LLVM BPF targets often produce objects consumed by libbpf loaders.
LLVM BPF backend lowers to BPF objects that libbpf loads; not the IR spec itself.
GCC BPF backends exist in some stacks; loaders remain libbpf-shaped.
